set.body:
Outcome

Replace universal Response and position-aligned metadata with typed columns bound to an exact sample axis.

Acceptance

- Categorical targets, numeric targets, run IDs, item IDs, subject IDs, and covariates use Column[S,A].
- Construction rejects length, owner, duplicate-key, and reordering mismatches.
- Reindexing preserves semantic keys and multiplicity correctly.
- Wrong-axis use fails at bind time or compile time with tested messages.
set.title: P1.3: add axis-bound Column values and alignment operations
